notes.title: Updates Notes for Dec 8 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to the new patch!
The highlight is for sure the new ACOG scope!

The other things fixed are as follows


 Kill% code fixed + UI should no longer overlap
 Blood splashes collide with the level geometry
 Timer text no longer shows over settings					
 ADS recoil values reduced significantly
 A lot of buttons were fixed				
 Laser works better + 2 of them for added effect

notes.title: Many Little Changes
notes.content:
- Kill percentage and rank calculation bug fixed.
- Epilepsy warning added.
- Muzzle flare light reduced.
- Ending screen "Return To Main Menu" button fixed.
- Z-fighting fixed.
- Switched "Press Enter" to "Press Jump"
